Here's a short, professional apology email template:

**Subject:** Apology — [brief context, e.g., "Missed deadline" / "Meeting conflict"]

Hi [Name],

I’m sorry for [specific issue — e.g., "missing yesterday’s deadline on the Q3 report" / "not being able to attend today’s sync"]. It was [brief reason, no over-explaining — e.g., "an unexpected priority shift" / "a scheduling oversight on my part"], and I own the impact it had on you/the team.

I’ve [what you’re doing to fix/prevent — e.g., "submitted the report this morning" / "rescheduled for Thursday 10am and blocked the time"]. Please let me know if there’s anything else I can do to make this right.

Thanks for your patience,  
[Your name]

---

PLAN: Ask the user for the specific situation and colleague's name to personalize the email.  
PLAN: Offer 2–3 tone variations (formal, casual, brief) based on their relationship.  
PLAN: Suggest a clear subject line and a concrete follow-up action to include.
